views.name: classes_with_room_and_building
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Classes.ClassID AS ClassID,
  Classes.SubjectID AS SubjectID,
  Classes.ClassRoomID AS ClassRoomID,
  Classes.Credits AS Credits,
  Classes.StartDate AS StartDate,
  Classes.StartTime AS StartTime,
  Classes.Duration AS Duration,
  Classes.MondaySchedule AS MondaySchedule,
  Classes.TuesdaySchedule AS TuesdaySchedule,
  Classes.WednesdaySchedule AS WednesdaySchedule,
  Classes.ThursdaySchedule AS ThursdaySchedule,
  Classes.FridaySchedule AS FridaySchedule,
  Classes.SaturdaySchedule AS SaturdaySchedule,
  Class_Rooms.BuildingCode AS BuildingCode,
  Class_Rooms.PhoneAvailable AS PhoneAvailable,
  Buildings.BuildingName AS BuildingName,
  Buildings.NumberOfFloors AS NumberOfFloors,
  Buildings.ElevatorAccess AS ElevatorAccess,
  Buildings.SiteParkingAvailable AS SiteParkingAvailable
FROM Classes
LEFT JOIN Class_Rooms ON Classes.ClassRoomID = Class_Rooms.ClassRoomID
LEFT JOIN Buildings ON Class_Rooms.BuildingCode = Buildings.BuildingCode
views.description: Denormalized view of Classes joined to their Class_Rooms and Buildings. Use this when you need class scheduling info together with room and building attributes (e.g., find classes by building, room phone availability, elevator access). | Use for: List classes offered in a particular building or room; Find classes that meet on specific weekdays in buildings with elevator access; Aggregate class counts or total credits by building

views.name: student_enrollments_with_status_and_student
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Student_Schedules.StudentID AS StudentID,
  Student_Schedules.ClassID AS ClassID,
  Student_Schedules.ClassStatus AS ClassStatus,
  Student_Schedules.Grade AS Grade,
  Students.StudFirstName AS StudFirstName,
  Students.StudLastName AS StudLastName,
  Students.StudStreetAddress AS StudStreetAddress,
  Students.StudCity AS StudCity,
  Students.StudState AS StudState,
  Students.StudZipCode AS StudZipCode,
  Students.StudAreaCode AS StudAreaCode,
  Students.StudPhoneNumber AS StudPhoneNumber,
  Students.StudGPA AS StudGPA,
  Students.StudMajor AS StudMajor,
  Student_Class_Status.ClassStatusDescription AS ClassStatusDescription
FROM Student_Schedules
LEFT JOIN Students ON Student_Schedules.StudentID = Students.StudentID
LEFT JOIN Student_Class_Status ON Student_Schedules.ClassStatus = Student_Class_Status.ClassStatus
views.description: Enrollment-level view combining Student_Schedules, Students, and Student_Class_Status. Use for analyses that need student attributes and enrollment status/grade alongside class IDs. | Use for: Compute grade distributions or averages for a class; List students currently enrolled vs completed classes; Join student demographics to enrollment outcomes

views.name: faculty_with_staff_details
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Faculty.StaffID AS StaffID,
  Faculty.Title AS Title,
  Faculty.Status AS Status,
  Faculty.Tenured AS Tenured,
  Staff.StfFirstName AS StfFirstName,
  Staff.StfLastname AS StfLastname,
  Staff.StfStreetAddress AS StfStreetAddress,
  Staff.StfCity AS StfCity,
  Staff.StfState AS StfState,
  Staff.StfZipCode AS StfZipCode,
  Staff.StfAreaCode AS StfAreaCode,
  Staff.StfPhoneNumber AS StfPhoneNumber,
  Staff.Salary AS Salary,
  Staff.DateHired AS DateHired,
  Staff.Position AS Position
FROM Faculty
LEFT JOIN Staff ON Faculty.StaffID = Staff.StaffID
views.description: Faculty records augmented with Staff personal and employment details. Use when analyzing faculty by salary, hire date, or contact info alongside faculty attributes like Tenured. | Use for: Compare faculty salaries by tenure status; Find faculty hired before/after a date (use DateHired filter externally); Contact lists of faculty with titles and positions

views.name: subject_with_category_and_department
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Subjects.SubjectID AS SubjectID,
  Subjects.CategoryID AS CategoryID,
  Subjects.SubjectCode AS SubjectCode,
  Subjects.SubjectName AS SubjectName,
  Subjects.SubjectPreReq AS SubjectPreReq,
  Subjects.SubjectDescription AS SubjectDescription,
  Categories.CategoryDescription AS CategoryDescription,
  Categories.DepartmentID AS DepartmentID
FROM Subjects
LEFT JOIN Categories ON Subjects.CategoryID = Categories.CategoryID
views.description: Subjects joined to Categories and the Category's Department. Useful when analyzing subjects by academic department or category descriptions. | Use for: List subjects offered by department or category; Find subject prerequisites and descriptions grouped by category

views.name: classes_schedule_pattern
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ClassID AS ClassID,
  SubjectID AS SubjectID,
  ClassRoomID AS ClassRoomID,
  Credits AS Credits,
  StartDate AS StartDate,
  StartTime AS StartTime,
  Duration AS Duration,
  MondaySchedule AS MondaySchedule,
  TuesdaySchedule AS TuesdaySchedule,
  WednesdaySchedule AS WednesdaySchedule,
  ThursdaySchedule AS ThursdaySchedule,
  FridaySchedule AS FridaySchedule,
  SaturdaySchedule AS SaturdaySchedule,
  (CASE WHEN MondaySchedule=1 THEN 'Mon' ELSE '' END) ||
  (CASE WHEN TuesdaySchedule=1 THEN (CASE WHEN MondaySchedule=1 THEN ',' ELSE '' END) || 'Tue' ELSE '' END) ||
  (CASE WHEN WednesdaySchedule=1 THEN (CASE WHEN MondaySchedule=1 OR TuesdaySchedule=1 THEN ',' ELSE '' END) || 'Wed' ELSE '' END) ||
  (CASE WHEN ThursdaySchedule=1 THEN (CASE WHEN MondaySchedule=1 OR TuesdaySchedule=1 OR WednesdaySchedule=1 THEN ',' ELSE '' END) || 'Thu' ELSE '' END) ||
  (CASE WHEN FridaySchedule=1 THEN (CASE WHEN MondaySchedule=1 OR TuesdaySchedule=1 OR WednesdaySchedule=1 OR ThursdaySchedule=1 THEN ',' ELSE '' END) || 'Fri' ELSE '' END) ||
  (CASE WHEN SaturdaySchedule=1 THEN (CASE WHEN MondaySchedule=1 OR TuesdaySchedule=1 OR WednesdaySchedule=1 OR ThursdaySchedule=1 OR FridaySchedule=1 THEN ',' ELSE '' END) || 'Sat' ELSE '' END) AS MeetingDays,
  (COALESCE(MondaySchedule,0) + COALESCE(TuesdaySchedule,0) + COALESCE(WednesdaySchedule,0) + COALESCE(ThursdaySchedule,0) + COALESCE(FridaySchedule,0) + COALESCE(SaturdaySchedule,0)) AS MeetingDaysCount
FROM Classes
views.description: One row per ClassID with a derived textual meeting_pattern flag per weekday plus a compact MeetingDays string and MeetingDaysCount. Useful to filter or group classes by which weekdays they meet without repeating boolean columns. | Use for: Filter classes that meet on specific combinations of days; Summarize classes by number of meeting days; Create human-readable meeting day labels for schedules

views.name: faculty_subject_proficiency
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  StaffID AS StaffID,
  COUNT(SubjectID) AS SubjectCount,
  AVG(ProficiencyRating) AS AvgProficiencyRating,
  MAX(ProficiencyRating) AS MaxProficiencyRating,
  MIN(ProficiencyRating) AS MinProficiencyRating
FROM Faculty_Subjects
GROUP BY StaffID
views.description: Aggregate view of Faculty_Subjects showing per-StaffID summary statistics (count of subjects, avg/max/min proficiency). Use when comparing faculty breadth and proficiency across subjects. | Use for: Rank faculty by average proficiency; Find faculty with the most subject proficiencies; Filter faculty by min/max proficiency thresholds

views.name: student_gpa_summary_by_major
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  StudMajor AS StudMajor,
  COUNT(StudentID) AS StudentCount,
  AVG(StudGPA) AS AvgStudGPA,
  MAX(StudGPA) AS MaxStudGPA,
  MIN(StudGPA) AS MinStudGPA
FROM Students
GROUP BY StudMajor
views.description: Per-major aggregate of student counts and GPA statistics. Use for departmental performance summaries and comparisons across majors. | Use for: Compare average GPA across majors; Identify majors with largest enrollment; Spot majors with wide GPA spread

views.name: instructor_class_load
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Faculty_Classes.StaffID AS StaffID,
  COUNT(Faculty_Classes.ClassID) AS ClassCount,
  SUM(Classes.Credits) AS TotalCredits
FROM Faculty_Classes
LEFT JOIN Classes ON Faculty_Classes.ClassID = Classes.ClassID
GROUP BY Faculty_Classes.StaffID
views.description: Counts classes and total credits taught per instructor (Faculty_Classes joined to Classes). Useful to measure teaching load per StaffID and to rank or filter heavy/low loads. | Use for: Find instructors teaching the most classes or credits; Allocate teaching resources by instructor

views.name: classes_ranked_by_startdate
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ClassID AS ClassID,
  SubjectID AS SubjectID,
  StartDate AS StartDate,
  StartTime AS StartTime,
  Credits AS Credits,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SubjectID ORDER BY StartDate DESC, StartTime DESC) AS SubjectStartRank
FROM Classes
views.description: Classes annotated with a rank ordering by StartDate then StartTime per SubjectID. Useful as a reusable way to get latest/earliest classes per subject (downstream WHERE rank<=k). | Use for: Get latest class offerings per subject; Select top-k most recent classes for each subject

views.name: student_grade_rank_within_class
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  StudentID AS StudentID,
  ClassID AS ClassID,
  Grade AS Grade,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ClassID ORDER BY Grade DESC) AS GradeRankInClass
FROM Student_Schedules
views.description: Ranks students within each ClassID by Grade (descending). Useful to retrieve top-performing students per class by applying WHERE grade_rank <= k downstream. | Use for: List top students per class; Identify students on grade-based leaderboards per class

views.name: faculty_category_membership
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Faculty_Categories.StaffID AS StaffID,
  Faculty_Categories.CategoryID AS CategoryID,
  Categories.CategoryDescription AS CategoryDescription,
  Categories.DepartmentID AS DepartmentID
FROM Faculty_Categories
LEFT JOIN Categories ON Faculty_Categories.CategoryID = Categories.CategoryID
views.description: Mapping of Faculty (via Staff) to Categories with category descriptions and department. Use for analyses combining faculty, their classification categories, and departmental context. | Use for: Find faculty by category or department; Count faculty per category
